title: Draft contract of mzLab workflows: step descriptor step/1, plan mzflow/2 (field steps) and run record prov/1
description: Study draft (docs/studi/WORKFLOW_MODULARI.md §4), not used by the program yet. Three documents: a step describes itself (step/1, one per step and version, shipped with the module that runs it, with its selectable algorithms); a workflow lists step instances wired by references (steps of mzflow/2, beside the operations log of mzflow/1); a run writes what it used and made (prov/1, a subset of PROV-JSON). Every name, id, description, label and error key of the modules is in English.

dataType.description: Typed data between steps. raw = vendor file set (one sample); mzml = mzML 1.1 (indexedmzML when written by mzLab); mzidx = mzLab scan index (docs/agenti/mzidx.md); xic = one chromatogram; peaks = features of one file (.mzfeatf); rtmap = RT correction of a series; table = aligned feature table (.mzfeat); samples = roles and times (the campioni/2 record); spectra = MS2 lists; library = a spectral library (.mzlib, or MSP/MGF/GNPS JSON compiled to it); formulas = ranked molecular formula candidates per feature, with the MS1 isotope and MS2 subformula evidence; candidates = ranked identity candidates per feature (library hits, in silico structures, suspects) with scores and evidence; annot = the chosen annotation per row with its identification level (interp/1, levels); tp = product view (tp/1); structure = a mol/1 record, format owned by the structure study (docs/studi/STRUTTURA_DATO*.md, not this draft); transform = a parent -> product transformation with atom mapping (transform1, a subset of trasf/1 of that study); comparison = differences between the outputs of two or more algorithms run on the same data (written by meta.compare); qc = quality numbers; report = terminal export (CSV, XLSX, HTML).

facets.description: facets of the data read from it: resolution (hr, lr), polarity, ms_levels, samples

applicability.description: when an algorithm fits the data, so that the interface can suggest it; facets read from the incoming data, plus what the method needs

peak_fwhm_s.description: range of chromatographic peak widths (FWHM, seconds) where the method is known to work

needs.description: inputs or sample roles the method cannot work without

note.description: one sentence for the suggestion, in English

many.description: a list, one per file of the series

accepts.description: other types this input takes besides type (COMUNICAZIONE.md §2)

requires.description: facets the incoming data must have; checked by plan.check, or by the step when they are not known yet

paramSchema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 of the parameters (type object). The form is generated from it: title, description, default, minimum, maximum, enum. Extra keywords: x-unit (ppm, Da, min, s, counts, fraction), x-advanced (hidden behind 'More'), x-group (a box of the form), x-estimate (absent value = estimated by the step, which then writes the value and its proof in prov/1), x-noresult (does not change the result: memory budget, threads; left out of the fingerprint).

id.description: unique inside the step, e.g. masstrace, centwave

version.description: raised whenever this algorithm can give a different output; part of the cache key

doc.description: one paragraph for the help of the form, in English

source.description: the original paper (DOI) the implementation is written from

params.description: parameters of this algorithm only; the common params of the step apply to all

status.description: planned: listed for the design, not selectable

version.description: raised whenever the same inputs and parameters can give a different output (like parameter_version of mzmine, but tied to the result)

doc.description: one paragraph for the help of the form, in English

cv.description: PSI-MS term of the action, when one exists (MS:1000035 peak picking, MS:1000544 conversion to mzML, MS:1000745 retention time alignment)

package.description: module family of the Flow palette: core (reading, features, table), attributio (identification, regulatory lists, ecotox), tabui (transformation products, positions, drawing); a family groups steps on the palette, it is not a separate app

params.description: parameters common to every algorithm of the step

runs_in.description: where the step runs: the .wasm module and its fixed size ceiling, and/or native (CLI, desktop)

deterministic.description: true: same input hashes + same id@version + same canonical parameters give the same output bytes, native and WASM

errors.description: the error keys the step may return (the shape is the one of the API: {error, error_key, params})

algorithms.description: selectable methods with the same in and out ports; a step without the field has one implicit algorithm

default_algorithm.description: the best known for the typical case; required when algorithms is present

ports_from.description: meta steps only: in ports are those of the step named by params.step, out ports add one variant per run

per_item.description: runs once per element of its many input, in parallel; outputs are gathered by index

converts.description: a registered conversion: the plan check proposes it when a wire joins from to to

cost.description: relative cost used to break ties between conversion paths

memory_hint_bytes.description: expected heap peak per item, from heap_peak_bytes of earlier runs; the planner admits steps within the memory budget

evidence.description: the bench measure that justifies the values

algorithm.description: an id of algorithms; absent = default_algorithm

presets.description: named parameter sets, each for one algorithm; Auto takes the first whose when matches the input facets

ref.description: file:NAME (an entry of inputs) or STEP.OUTPUT (an output of an earlier step instance)

id.description: unique in the workflow: the same kind can appear twice (mass detection on MS1 and on MS2)

params.description: only the values that differ from the defaults; the canonical form fills the rest

preset.description: a key of presets of the step; params then hold only the differences

algorithm.description: an id of the algorithms of the step; absent = the one of the preset, else default_algorithm

steps.description: a DAG: every reference points to an earlier instance; the interface shows a chain while the graph has one path

operations.description: the log of mzflow/1, unchanged; a reader also takes the mzflow/1 keys formato, programma and operazioni

params.description: canonical: every value, estimated ones included

estimates.description: parameter -> proof of the estimate (as the proofs of feature_pipeline/1)

cached.description: true when the output came from the cache key (input hashes, id@version, params_sha256)

algorithm.description: the algorithm that ran, id@version (e.g. masstrace@1)

transform1.description: parent -> product of one transformation, with the atom mapping (the fields of trasf/1 of the structure study that the workflow reads; the other fields pass through). Structures are referenced by hash, never copied; atom indices are the canonical indices of the mol/1 record, never those of a SMILES

parent.description: sha256 of the canonical core (atoms, bonds, stereo, groups; no coords, props or regions) of the parent structure

product.description: sha256 of the canonical core (atoms, bonds, stereo, groups; no coords, props or regions) of the product structure; absent when only the change is known (partial structure, level 3b)

delta.description: formula change, e.g. +O -H2 (as parz/1 and the hypotheses)

rule.description: id of the rule or library entry that proposed it (e.g. a regole_tp/2 rule)

map.description: [parent atom, product atom or null when lost]

sites.description: parent atoms where the change may be, with their support (as posiz/1)
